label: A total holder of a lackable act gives being, from the esse-side support of C*-holding (inference)
rule: The giver of being holds every lackable act; the total holder is the only holder
meaning: New non-transcription conditional derivation. Let z totally hold x in r, with x in act in r and able to lack that act. By the lackable-being bridge x is in act as to being and could lack being; by the esse instance some g other than x presently gives x being; by accident-inclusive conservation g presently actualizes x in r; since z is the only holder of x in r, g is z. So on the bundle that supports C* in the holding sense (section 9.1), total holding of a lackable act is held only by a giver of being: the total-holding series of lackable acts is a series of givers of being, and the total-holder repair passes the load of the holding route to the esse-root routes' givers of being. All premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
